edits.old: Legacy SCR-45 Data quality carries two states, and the harness asserts both through the gateway-bff composite route:
edits.new: Legacy SCR-45 Data quality carries five states, and the harness asserts each one through the gateway-bff composite route:

edits.old: | Empty | The data steward opens Data quality for a business date with no breaks | The route answers with an empty break list for that business date, and the run report records the state it read |
edits.new: | Empty | Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-1021) | The route answers with an empty break list for that business date, and the run report records the state it read |

edits.old: | Error | The data steward opens Data quality and the route returns an error | The screen shows the error and no break list, the run report records the state it read, and no break is rounded away (BR3) |
edits.new: | Error | Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-1021) | The screen shows the error and no break list, the run report records the state it read, and no break is rounded away (BR3) |

edits.old: | No access | A caller without Platform administration R opens Data quality | The route refuses the caller and returns no break list (TC-DM-007-04-ITG) |
edits.new: | No access | Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-1021) | The route refuses the caller and returns no break list (TC-DM-007-04-ITG) |

edits.old: And no reconciliation run starts and no break row is written
edits.new:
And no reconciliation run starts and no break row is written

  Scenario: AC6 Each business rule in section 8 is traced to a test (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the business rules BR1 to BR8 in section 8
    When the story is checked against section 16
    Then each rule BR1 to BR8 is named by a test case row in section 16
    And each rule that is an architecture constraint is named by a guardrail or boundary test instead

  Scenario: AC7 A consumed call that fails or does not answer is reported and no break is rounded away (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the gateway-bff composite route for SCR-45 composes the reconciliation extract of rwb-source-data with the owners' reads
    And one consumed call returns an error or does not answer
    When the harness calls the composite route for business date "2026-12-31"
    Then the answer is an error and no partial break list is returned
    And the run report records the failed call and the state it read
    And no break is rounded away (BR3)

edits.old: | TC-DM-007-04-ITG | Access; ITG AC5 | Component | RW-OFF caller without Platform administration R |
edits.new:
| TC-DM-007-04-ITG | Access; ITG AC5 | Component | RW-OFF caller without Platform administration R |
| TC-DM-007-05-ITG | ITG AC6 | Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-ITG-DM007-ITG-AC6) | Business rules BR1 to BR8 of section 8 |
| TC-DM-007-06-ITG | ITG AC7 | Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-ITG-DM007-ITG-AC7) | One consumed call of the composite route that fails or does not answer for business date 2026-12-31 |

edits.old: The four cases are the ITG copies of the legacy cases of the same number and carry the legacy data unchanged, with the two new criteria and the access refusal added at the levels shown.
edits.new: The four cases are the ITG copies of the legacy cases of the same number and carry the legacy data unchanged, with the two new criteria and the access refusal added at the levels shown. TC-DM-007-05-ITG and TC-DM-007-06-ITG cover the new AC6 and AC7 and have no legacy copy.

disposition.note: Intro now states five SCR-45 states. Empty, error and no access user-facing text is Not specified (CG-ALL-1021), as the screen spec lacks it.
AC6 added tracing BR1 to BR8 to section 16 tests. TC-DM-007-05-ITG added; test level Not specified in the source documents.
AC7 added for a failed or silent consumed call; TC-DM-007-06-ITG added. Test level Not specified in the source documents.
